_meta.purpose: RAG knowledge base for the AICTE Pragati Scholarship (Technical Degree and Technical Diploma) on the National Scholarship Portal, academic year 2026-27
_meta.overall_verification_summary: No fact in this file was verified against a live 2026-27 NSP or AICTE page. Only three sources were opened in full: the NSP All-Scholarships page and the AICTE home page (both returned cached 2024-25 content) and one institute-hosted PDF containing AICTE FAQ text. Every other source was read as a search-result snippet only. 2026-27 dates and the income-year wording come from third-party pages. DocMitra must send students to the live NSP scheme listing for dates, upload limits, income-certificate year and final requirements.

verification_legend.official_document_copy: Text authored by AICTE or the Government, read by me in a copy or snippet (institute-hosted PDF, aicte.gov.in snippet, myScheme page). It is NOT the live 2026-27 portal page and may belong to an older cycle.
verification_legend.secondary_source: Found only on third-party pages (news, coaching or aggregator sites, or a college's own summary). Not equal to an official guideline.
verification_legend.conflicting: Official-type or other sources disagree. Do not state one version as fact; tell the student to confirm on NSP or with the institute.
verification_legend.not_found: Could not be verified or found. Do not state as fact.
verification_legend.live_portal_required: Value changes by year or form; DocMitra must tell the student to read it on the live NSP page.
verification_legend.mixed: This record combines claims with different verification statuses. Consumers must use claim-level verification metadata where available and must not treat the entire record as verified merely because some claims come from an official document copy.

requirement_level_legend.officially_mandatory: Listed as required in AICTE-authored text read for this audit (not the live 2026-27 upload page).
requirement_level_legend.conditionally_required: Required only for some students (for example lateral entry, renewal or category claim).
requirement_level_legend.commonly_requested: Appears in college or third-party checklists but not confirmed in AICTE-authored text.
requirement_level_legend.not_verified: Could not be confirmed from any reliable source.

safety_rules_for_docmitra: Never ask a student for passwords, OTPs, full Aadhaar numbers or full bank account numbers in chat.
Do not guarantee scholarship approval, selection or payment. Selection is on merit among eligible applicants and awards are limited.
If a required fact is unknown, do not give a definitive eligibility decision; say what is missing and what to confirm.
For anything marked conflicting, not_found or live_portal_required, tell the student to confirm on scholarships.gov.in or with the institute scholarship cell.
Direct students only to scholarships.gov.in for applying. Warn them about look-alike sites and agents.
Keep answers short, plain and practical for Indian students.
known_gaps: No live 2026-27 NSP scheme page for Pragati Degree or Diploma was reachable; dates, upload limits and field labels are unverified against the live portal.
Official 2026-27 AICTE guideline PDF was not opened; rules are from AICTE FAQ text (Appendices dated 2021-22) and older guideline excerpts.
The myScheme page body and FAQ answers (document type and size, bonafide cases, application fee) were not readable; only headings and summary text were seen.
Accepted-bank list, document file formats and size limits (except as flagged), renewal mark or attendance thresholds and payment timeline were not found.
The other-scholarship restriction appears in AICTE FAQ text read through an institute-hosted copy but was not confirmed on the live NSP scheme page, so it is used only as an advisory prompt.

conflicts: One page says AICTE opened its portal on 2026-06-19 while others say NSP opened on 2026-06-01. Treat both as unverified and tell students to read the live NSP listing.
important_dates.urgency_rule: At runtime compare today's date with the application deadline. If it is on or before 2026-10-31, tell the student to apply and get institute verification started now and to confirm the date on NSP. scholarship_amount.agreed_across_sources: INR 50,000 per annum for every year of study; paid by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the student's bank account.
scholarship_amount.version_a_lump_sum: AICTE FAQ text (Appendices dated 2021-22) and a 2020-21 guideline excerpt describe INR 50,000 per annum as a lump sum towards college fee, computer purchase, stationery, books, equipment, software etc. with no additional grant for hostel or medical charges. myScheme-based summaries describe it the same way.
scholarship_amount.version_b_tuition_plus_incidentals: An older AICTE salient-features document and its copies describe tuition fee of INR 30,000 or actual (whichever is less) plus INR 2,000 per month for 10 months as incidentals; for students with tuition fee waiver or reimbursement, INR 30,000 for books, equipment, software, laptop/desktop, vehicle or competitive-exam fees.
scholarship_amount.reconciliation: Not reconciled. It is not confirmed which version applies in 2026-27.
scholarship_amount.docmitra_instruction: Say: 'The scholarship is INR 50,000 per year. How it is split or paid can differ by guideline version, so please check the current NSP/AICTE notice or ask your institute.' Do not state the INR 30,000 + INR 20,000 split as current fact. Do not give a payment date.

payment_mode.value: DBT into a general savings bank account in the student's own name that is Aadhaar-seeded. FRILL, minor and joint accounts are not accepted.

breakdown_components.component: Tuition fee up to INR 30,000 or actual, whichever is less
breakdown_components.note: Older AICTE salient-features text; not confirmed for 2026-27

breakdown_components.component: Incidentals INR 2,000 per month for 10 months (INR 20,000 per year)
breakdown_components.note: Older AICTE salient-features text; not confirmed for 2026-27

breakdown_components.component: Lump sum INR 50,000 for fees, computer, stationery, books, equipment, software
breakdown_components.note: Newer AICTE FAQ text and aggregator summaries; not confirmed on the live 2026-27 scheme page

Third-party lists (engineering, pharmacy, architecture, MBA, MCA, hotel management) disagree. Tell the student the course and institute must be AICTE-approved and to check the NSP course/institute selection or ask the institute.

excluded_courses.value: Non-technical courses, courses or institutes not approved by AICTE in the current year, dual-degree courses, post-graduate courses
excluded_courses.note: From AICTE FAQ list of reasons for direct rejection.

value: First year of the degree course
Second year of the degree course through lateral entry (LE)
admission_year.not_eligible_for_fresh: A student in 3rd year of a Degree/Diploma course is not eligible (AICTE FAQ Q3). A regular second-year student is not covered by the fresh rule as worded; she can continue only through renewal if already an awardee.

centralised_admission_and_management_quo.note: Older AICTE salient features and a 2025-26 college summary say admission should be through the centralised admission process of the State/Central Government, and third-party pages say management-quota students are not eligible. The AICTE FAQ eligibility list read does not state this. Do not treat as settled; ask the student to confirm with the institute.

family_income_limit.boundary_wording: AICTE FAQ text says 'less than Rs. 8 Lakh'; an older AICTE guideline says 'not more than 8 lakh'. If the certificate shows exactly INR 8,00,000, tell the student to confirm with the institute or NSP.
family_income_limit.married_girl_rule: For a married girl, the income of parents or in-laws, whichever is higher, is considered.

financial_year.details: Older AICTE guideline: income during the 'preceding financial year'. AICTE FAQ text (Appendix II and Q19): income 'for the current financial year' and rejection if the 'current year' certificate is not submitted. A 2025-26 college summary says 'preceding financial year'.
financial_year.docmitra_instruction: Do not state which financial year applies. Ask the student to confirm the required year on the live NSP upload page or with the institute scholarship cell before getting the certificate made.

preceding_financial_year: HowToHelp 2026-27 page (says previous year 2025-26 but also says certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026, which is internally inconsistent)
current_financial_year: AICTE FAQ text Appendix II and Q19 (institute-hosted copy)
scholarshipsinindia 2026-27 page (copy of AICTE text for Diploma)
secondary_source_tally.result: Still conflicting. No authoritative live source found. Do not state a year.

family_member_restriction.value: Maximum two girl children per family
family_member_restriction.note: Parent declaration states total daughters and whether the applicant is the first or second daughter applying.

merit_basis.value: Selection is on merit of the qualifying examination among eligible applicants in AICTE-approved institutions; eligibility does not guarantee selection.

reservation.value: As per Government of India norms (AICTE FAQ). Percentages of 15% SC, 7.5% ST and 27% OBC appear on a government site and a college summary.
reservation.note: Do not quote percentages as confirmed for 2026-27.

other_scholarship_restriction.exact_rule: AICTE FAQ text (read in an institute-hosted copy) says the candidate should not be a recipient of any Central Govt, State Govt or AICTE-sponsored scholarship, that students already receiving such a scholarship are not eligible (Q5), and gives a first-year B.E. student who is a PMSSS beneficiary as an example (Q6). Q18 separately lists 'student is availing a scholarship from other sources' among rejection reasons. None of this was confirmed on the live 2026-27 NSP page.
scope_notes: The confirmed scope is Central Government, State Government and AICTE-sponsored scholarships.
The wording 'other sources' in the Q18 list of rejection reasons is broader than the Q5-Q6 eligibility text; how private or non-government scholarships are treated was not confirmed.
A college-format student declaration reads: not availing any other scholarship from Central/State sources, and the student will inform non-government sources of her application status.
other_scholarship_restriction.docmitra_instruction: Treat as an advisory prompt, not a decisive condition. If the student says she receives a Central, State or AICTE scholarship, say: 'AICTE FAQ text says this may make you ineligible, but I could not confirm it on the live NSP page. Please confirm with your institute scholarship cell or NSP before applying.' Do not mark her not eligible. For private or non-government scholarships say the rule is not confirmed. If unknown, you may mention the point once and move on.

regions_note.value: AICTE FAQ text lists the number of awards for 23 States/UTs and says all eligible students in AICTE-approved institutions in Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura, Andaman & Nicobar, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, Jammu & Kashmir, Lakshadweep and Ladakh are eligible to apply.

number_of_awards.details: AICTE FAQ text (2025-26 era): 5,000 at Degree level and 5,000 at Diploma level for 23 States/UTs, plus eligible students in the north-eastern states and UTs listed above. Older AICTE salient features: 4,000 per annum (2,000 Degree and 2,000 Diploma). A 2025-26 college summary says 5,000 girls per year with fresh and renewal combined.
number_of_awards.docmitra_instruction: Say that awards are limited and the number differs by source; do not quote a figure.

renewal_and_continuation.rule: The scholarship is renewed for the next year of study on receipt of a renewal application through NSP with a Promotion Certificate duly certified by the Head of Institution (Appendix IV, issued by Director/Principal/Head of Institution with stamp and signature).
renewal_and_continuation.discontinuation_rule: If a candidate fails or drops out in a subsequent year, she is not eligible for further scholarship (Q7).

renewal_deadline.value: Same listed date as fresh applications (2026-10-31)

renewal_and_continuation.docmitra_instruction: Do not state any mark, attendance or other renewal threshold. Tell the student to follow the Renewal form on NSP and get the promotion certificate from the institute.

application_process.confirmed_by_aicte_faq: Apply online on NSP after the application process is notified (Q2). After submission, check details and ask the institute to verify and forward the application within the time shown on NSP (Q17).

steps.title: Check basic eligibility
steps.detail: Girl student; AICTE-approved course and institute; first year or lateral-entry second year; family income within the limit; not more than two daughters from the family. Also check with your institute whether any Central, State or AICTE scholarship you already receive affects eligibility.

steps.title: Confirm requirements on live NSP
steps.detail: Open the Pragati Degree or Diploma scheme listing and its Specifications/FAQ on scholarships.gov.in and note dates, upload sizes and the required financial year for the income certificate.

steps.title: Prepare documents
steps.detail: Use the checklist for your student type and get institute-issued certificates in the prescribed format.

steps.title: Register and apply on NSP
steps.detail: Complete One Time Registration (new students) or log in (renewal), choose the correct scheme (Degree or Diploma) and Fresh or Renewal, fill details exactly as on documents, upload documents and submit.

steps.title: Ask the institute to verify
steps.detail: The institute must verify and forward the application before its deadline. Follow your institute's own instructions for printouts or originals.

faqs.question: What is the last date for Pragati Scholarship 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Third-party pages list 31 October 2026 for students (fresh and renewal), 15 November 2026 for institute and defective-application verification, and 30 November 2026 for DNO/SNO/MNO verification. I could not confirm these on the live NSP page, so please check the Pragati scheme listing on scholarships.gov.in. Dates can be extended.

faqs.question: How much is the scholarship?
faqs.answer: INR 50,000 per year, paid by DBT. How it is divided (for example tuition plus monthly incidentals, or a lump sum for fees, books and equipment) is unverified for 2026-27, so please check the current NSP or AICTE notice or ask your institute.

faqs.question: What is the family income limit?
faqs.answer: INR 8 lakh per year from all sources. AICTE text says 'less than' INR 8 lakh in one place and 'not more than' in another, so if your certificate shows exactly INR 8 lakh, confirm with your institute. For a married girl, the higher income of parents or in-laws is considered.

faqs.question: Which financial year should my income certificate be for?
faqs.answer: This is not settled. AICTE FAQ text says the current financial year, while an older guideline and most 2026-27 third-party pages say the preceding financial year. None is a live official source, so please confirm the required year on the NSP upload page or with your institute before getting the certificate.

faqs.question: Can two sisters apply?
faqs.answer: A maximum of two girl children per family are eligible. The parent declaration records how many daughters there are and whether you are the first or second daughter applying. Each must separately meet all conditions and be selected on merit.

faqs.question: Is lateral entry covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Girls admitted to the second year of a Degree or Diploma course through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution are covered. The maximum duration is 3 years for Degree and 2 years for Diploma.

faqs.question: I am in 3rd year. Can I apply?
faqs.answer: AICTE FAQ text says a student in the 3rd year of a Degree or Diploma course is not eligible. Existing awardees continue through renewal.

faqs.question: I already get another scholarship. Can I still apply?
faqs.answer: AICTE FAQ text says students who receive a Central Government, State Government or AICTE-sponsored scholarship may not be eligible. I could not confirm this on the live NSP page, so please check with your institute scholarship cell or NSP before applying. For private scholarships the rule is not confirmed.

faqs.question: Which bank account should I use?
faqs.answer: A general savings account in your own name that is seeded with Aadhaar. Joint, minor and FRILL accounts are not accepted. I could not find an official list of accepted banks, so use what NSP shows.

faqs.question: How do I renew?
faqs.answer: Apply as a Renewal applicant on NSP with a Promotion Certificate certified by the Head of your institution. If you fail or drop out, you are not eligible for further scholarship. I could not find any minimum marks or attendance rule, so do not assume one.

faqs.question: Why can an application be rejected?
faqs.answer: AICTE's FAQ text lists these reasons for rejection: a non-technical course or a course or institute not approved by AICTE, a dual-degree or post-graduate course, and incomplete or wrong information. Income, promotion and Class 10/12 certificates are rejected if unclear, unsigned, unstamped, in the wrong name or from the wrong authority. The same list also mentions availing a scholarship from other sources; I could not confirm how that applies, so please check with your institute.

faqs.question: What size should my photo and signature be?
faqs.answer: I could not confirm the 2026-27 limits. A college summary mentions about 200 KB for the photo and 50 KB for the signature, but please follow the size and format shown on the live NSP upload page.

faqs.question: Where can I get help?
faqs.answer: Start with your institute's scholarship cell and the NSP helpdesk. AICTE text lists pragati@aicte-india.org with phone 011-29581118, and other pages list pragatisaksham@aicte-india.org. Please confirm which is current on NSP.

faqs.question: If I meet the conditions, will I definitely get the scholarship?
faqs.answer: No. Awards are limited and selection is on merit of the qualifying examination among eligible applicants. DocMitra cannot guarantee selection or payment.

common_user_mistakes: Waiting until the last day and not getting institute verification started
Getting an income certificate for the wrong financial year without checking the requirement
Choosing the wrong scheme (Degree or Diploma) or the wrong Fresh/Renewal option
Using a joint, minor or non-Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Uploading blurred, unsigned or unstamped certificates, or an Appendix I/IV certificate with missing details
Applying without checking with the institute whether an existing Central, State or AICTE scholarship affects eligibility

rag_chunks.text: The AICTE Pragati Scholarship is for girl students in AICTE-approved technical Degree and Diploma courses, admitted in the first year or the second year through lateral entry. It gives INR 50,000 per year by DBT (breakdown unverified) for up to 4 years (Degree) or 3 years (Diploma); lateral entry is up to 3 and 2 years. Family income limit is INR 8 lakh and up to two girls per family can benefit. Apply on scholarships.gov.in. Selection is on merit among eligible applicants, so approval is not guaranteed.

rag_chunks.text: The amount is INR 50,000 per year by DBT. Whether it is tuition up to INR 30,000 plus INR 2,000 a month for 10 months, or a lump sum for fees, books and equipment, is unverified for 2026-27. DocMitra must not state either breakdown as current fact.

Third-party pages list these 2026-27 dates: NSP opened 1 June 2026; students apply by 31 October 2026; defective-application and institute verification by 15 November 2026; DNO/SNO/MNO verification by 30 November 2026. These were not confirmed on the live NSP page and extensions can happen, so students must check scholarships.gov.in.

Family income limit is INR 8 lakh per year from all sources; for a married girl the higher income of parents or in-laws is considered. The certificate must be from a competent authority such as Tehsildar, with signature and stamp. Whether the certificate should be for the current or the preceding financial year is conflicting across sources, so the student should confirm on NSP or with the institute. Exactly INR 8 lakh is also unclear because the wording varies between 'less than' and 'not more than'. A recheck of 2026-27 third-party pages mostly says 'preceding' while AICTE FAQ text says 'current', so the year stays unresolved.

AICTE FAQ text lists: Class 10 certificate and marksheet; Class 12 for Degree level; ITI certificate for lateral entry to Diploma or Diploma certificate for lateral entry to Degree; category certificate if applicable; study or bonafide certificate; annual family income certificate; parent declaration; promotion certificate for renewal. Aadhaar and an Aadhaar-seeded bank account in the student's name are mandatory. Photo and signature sizes, admission letter, tuition fee receipt, domicile certificate and bank mandate were not confirmed from AICTE text; students should follow the live NSP upload page.

AICTE FAQ text says a student who receives a Central Government, State Government or AICTE-sponsored scholarship may not be eligible. This was not confirmed on the live NSP page, so DocMitra treats it as an advisory prompt only: it asks the student to confirm with the institute or NSP and never rejects her on this basis. Private or non-government scholarships are not covered by a confirmed rule.

Renewal is done on NSP with a Promotion Certificate certified by the Head of Institution. A student who fails or drops out is not eligible for further scholarship. No minimum marks or attendance rule was found, so none should be quoted. Renewal uses the same listed deadline as fresh applications (secondary_source).
